title: Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
text: read_gpx_stream(): Read GPX file. Garmin TrackPointExtension fields (hr, cad, atemp) read via namespace-stripped XPath, GDAL extension flag required. read_tcx_stream(): Read TCX file. Strava's TCX exports carry leading whitespace <?xml> declaration, file read text trimmed parsing. read_fit_stream(): Read FIT file (requires FITfileR package). records() may return several tibbles file multiple record definitions; bound. Record fields vary files, safe getter returns NA absent fields.
